messages:
emily_cs: Quick heads-up from today's health sweep — three midmarket accounts popped into red for different reasons. proposing a short multi-arm micro-saves experiment rather than one big play.

emily_cs: Plan (short): run 3 lightweight interventions in parallel for 10 days, measure delta in health_score and key usage. keep it low-effort, high-signal.

emily_cs: Arms: 1) Live 30m mini-demo + success checklist, 2) $500 one-time workload credit + quota bump, 3) Targeted enablement doc + exec email nudge.

raj_sales: sounds good. which accounts and what are renewal timing/ARR? prioritize by risk and ARR.

emily_cs: Accounts: Ridgewell (95k ARR, renewal in 18 days), HarborIQ (52k, 92 days), VectorLane (30k, 9 days). VectorLane is most urgent.

nana_ps: I can own the live demo for VectorLane — 30m slot this week. propose agenda: 5m recap, 15m focused walkthrough on onboarding flow, 10m unblock + 3 immediate action items.

lee_data: here's the trigger: VectorLane embedding call volume down 72% last 7d, 4 failed onboarding pipelines. SQL snippet I used to pull: 
```
SELECT account_id, metric, date, pct_change
FROM account_metrics
WHERE account_id IN ('vectorlane','ridgewell','harboriq')
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 30;
```

sam_ops: can approve a temporary quota bump for Ridgewell for up to 14 days. I'll open OPS ticket OPS-1199 and link it here.

emily_cs: thanks Sam. For HarborIQ I want to try the credit + exec nudge (arm 2) — Raj can you lead the exec outreach? I'll draft email variants A/B.

raj_sales: yep. i'll draft the exec outreach focused on ROI + next 3 wins. also prepping a one-pager for Ridgewell renewal play if needed.

emily_cs: draft exec email A (concise):
```
Subject: Quick 15m to unblock HarborIQ production tests
Hi <Name>,
Noticed test traffic dropped. We can add a $500 workload credit and schedule a short session with our platform engineer this week. 15 minutes?
Thanks,
Emily
```

emily_cs: draft email B (product-led):
"We shipped a checklist + sample payloads to cut your onboarding time by 40%. Want me to walk through?"

nana_ps: I'll author the checklist for the demo and include 3 sample payloads and exact config diffs. will drop link by EOD.

lee_data: i'll build a small dashboard card in CS view to track these 3 accounts (health_score, embedding_calls, onboarding_jobs_failed). will push by tomorrow morning.

trial_signal_bot: Risk alert: vectorlane flagged CHURN-P1 at 2026-03-18T14:02:17Z — reason: renewal_imminent + deployment_failures.

emily_cs: timeline: Day 0 (today) open OPS-1199, push dashboard, draft emails. Day 1 schedule demo (VectorLane), Day 2 run credit + exec outreach (HarborIQ), Day 3-10 monitor, Day 11 review metrics and decide next action.

sam_ops: OPS-1199 created: https://jira.redwood/OPS-1199 — Ridgewell granted 14-day soft bump. :white_check_mark:

raj_sales: will coordinate exec reachouts and update renewal one-pager for Ridgewell.

nana_ps: demo slot booked with VectorLane for 2026-03-19 11:00 PT. agenda pinned in calendar invite.

lee_data: pushing cohort delta viz now. link: https://dashboards.redwood/cs/cards/micro-saves-experiment

emily_cs: success criteria: +12% embedding call volume OR resolved onboarding_jobs within 10 days. secondary: no downgrade at renewal.

raj_sales: if we get partial lift, prepare staged offer (extended credit + discounted month) — keep pricing ops-aligned.

emily_cs: agreed. we'll run a quick postmortem after Day 10 to capture what worked and whether to roll out as a standard micro-save play.

trial_signal_bot: Follow-up check scheduled: 2026-03-28T09:00:00Z (micro-saves review).

emily_cs: tagging owners: react with :thumbsup: when your task is done so I can mark the thread complete.

raj_sales: :thumbsup:

nana_ps: :thumbsup:

lee_data: :thumbsup:

sam_ops: :thumbsup:

emily_cs: thanks team — keep notes in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood/micro-saves-2026
